title: VerifiedOS proof reading, version 1
description: What Rocq printed about every constant the proof audit's native inventory names, per module, under Set Printing All, Set Printing Universes and the audit's depth and width. A reading decides nothing alone: two readings are compared, and every entry outside provenance must be byte-identical for them to agree. It accepts no proof and does not show that a statement expresses its requirement.

reader.description: What produced every answer: a difference here is a difference between the readings, never a normalization.

query_flags.description: The proof gate's compile flags, under which every query ran.

inventory_settings.description: The proof audit's inventory settings, whose Search enumerates the constants.

reading_settings.description: The printing settings every Check, About and Print ran under.

provenance.description: The compile this reading was taken from. Never compared: two compiles of one source may differ in their objects and mean the same thing.

opacity.description: About's opacity sentence; n/a for a kind that states none.

check.description: The answer to Check @name, fresh universe levels of the query itself renamed ?u1, ?u2 by first appearance.

about.description: The answer to About name, less its Declared in location lines.

print.description: The answer to Print name for a transparent constant or an inductive; null otherwise.
